physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real operator workflow has been exercised against this artifact. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. No screenshot or video of this environment's actual rendered output was available or captured either - see docs/phase-3-5-1-ux-audit.md section 0.

obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there.
